access_route.text: the lock-warden rows them across and lets them in through the winch loft, oar over shoulder

cipher_form.text: tide arithmetic: add the moon day to the posted hour and carry past twelve to read each hoist

access_route.text: winding the tide engine's counterweight to its top mark lifts the winch loft hatch ajar
the dry sluice culvert, walkable at low water since the new channel took the flow

curiosity.text: generations of keepers' initials scratched shoulder-high along the catwalk door frame

hint_carrier.text: hand-polish on the hoist levers, deepest where the right pulls land, faint where they never do

curiosity.text: toll ledgers in waterproof bindings, every cargo and flood of eighty years ruled in red

hint_carrier.text: the weir gates sluice in a repeating run, long, long, short, the same run the flags spell
a gate cross-section pinned in the winch loft, its margins working tide sums beside each hoist

obstacle.text: the unlit tail-race tunnel, dry underfoot and black, walked by counting paces between light wells

curiosity.text: the tide-engine racks rising and easing as the river breathes against the gates

hint_carrier.text: depth figures stamped up the engine racks, climbing by the same carry the hoists use

remedy.text: the posted rule at the racks: ease back a quarter turn before asking a full one

contents.text: Maren's last workbook, ending in a letter that asks its finder only to keep the river honest

loft_signature.text: a rooftop reed garden still green, watered by a cistern drip the engineer rigged to last

n_end_secret.mechanism: the workshop adopts the friends as its quiet caretakers, a role nobody assigned but everybody means

safeguard.text: fine river silt dusted on the strongroom floor keeps every footprint for the warden's morning read

n_end_caught.mechanism: the strongroom's true safeguard announces the overreach, and the keeper arrives before the door does

n_end_library.mechanism: closing time arrives mid-page and the keeper walks them out gently, with a promise to hold the ledgers

n_end_giveup.mechanism: a level look at the crossing convinces them that this piece would cost more than it is worth tonight

n_end_timeout.mechanism: the closing horns sound before the guess lands, and the fit must wait for another day

n_end_stuck.mechanism: the keeper's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and the crew honors it as part of the job

n_end_hero.mechanism: the recovered piece quietly restores something the settlement had given up on, proof enough without a fuss

n_end_keepsake.mechanism: the maker's letter asks its finders to choose what to keep quiet, and they choose the keepsake
